methodologyNotes: Each vendor re-verified by WebFetch against its official pricing page on 2026-06-18, supplemented by WebSearch corroboration (G2, Capterra) only where the official page was demo-gated or returned 403. OptinMonster: monthlyUsd now reflects the standard annual monthly-equivalent (annual list price / 12); the previously listed $19/$32/$49/$82 matched neither the real pure-monthly rates ($21/$57/$87/$147 from optinmonster.com/pricing/monthly) nor the annual-equivalent and were corrected. The 60%-off first-year intro teaser is noted, not used as the headline price. Privy: official page surfaces only Convert ($24) and the email plan ($30, real name 'Starter'); the 'Growth' ($45, SMS) tier is corroborated on G2/PricingNow and retained; the $30 plan was mislabeled 'Email' and renamed. Sumo REMOVED: sumo.com/pricing now redirects to an unrelated AI product ('Refract'); no verifiable official live popup-tool pricing page exists and the $49 Pro / free-10K figures are stale aggregator data contradicted by the current trial-then-$4/mo model. Wisepops: dollar figures match the official support article (effective June 1 2026) but the writer's tier names (Starter/Growth/Pro/Scale/Enterprise) are fabricated — the source presents tiers by pageview threshold only and the actual named plans are Essential/Intelligence; tiers relabeled by pageview band. Sleeknote publishes EUR only (monthlyUsd null). Hello Bar pricing page returned 403; figures verified against the official Hello Bar support article. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

No annual discount listed.

plans.notes: Starts at $24/mo for up to 10,000 monthly pageviews. Includes popups, landing pages, embedded forms, A/B testing, spin-to-win, exit intent, cart saver. Price scales with pageview volume.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Starts at $30/mo for up to 1,500 mailable contacts. Includes unlimited email sends, automations, advanced targeting, 250 free SMS credits. Price scales with mailable contact count. (Draft called this plan 'Email'; official page labels the email product 'Starter'.)

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Starts at $45/mo. Everything in the email plan plus SMS marketing (1,250 SMS credits). Price scales with mailable contacts. Not surfaced on the live privy.com/pricing page; corroborated via G2/PricingNow.

limits: Convert plan priced by pageview volume (starts 10K/mo)
Email/Starter plan priced by mailable contacts (starts 1,500)
Aggregators reference a free 100-contact branded plan not surfaced on the official pricing page
